reuse: Completed shards are immutable and reused after exact path/size/mtime/config identity comparison. Raw632 symbol admissions/events/native fills/trades remain local. No data downloads, content hashes or second-framework simulation.
tests: runpy.run_path('tests/evaluation/test_monday_confirmed_r.py'); invoke every test_ function in isolated vectorbt-python.10 passed before historical execution.
boundaries: Full-history rows include closed trades across year boundaries; select2025 excludes trades crossing2026, pre2025 excludes trades crossing2025. Source-gap/end cases are censored and never booked as closed wins.
short_target_boundary: A nonpositive short TP price is physically unreachable; the original pin stop remains, and any unclosed outcome is censored. Long is the primary user-requested cohort.
